description: Financial statements of one Taiwan-listed company from the MOPS XBRL filings (since 2013 Q1), newest period first: period=quarterly (default) gives the latest 8 single quarters, annual the latest 5 fiscal years. Each period has income (revenue, cost_of_revenue, gross_profit, operating_expenses, operating_income, non_operating_income, net_interest_income and provision_expense for banks, pretax_income, tax_expense, net_income, net_income_parent, eps_basic, eps_diluted), balance (cash_and_equivalents, accounts_receivable, inventory, total_current_assets, ppe_net, total_assets, total_current_liabilities, borrowings, total_liabilities, share_capital, equity_parent, total_equity) and cash_flow (operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, investing_cash_flow, financing_cash_flow, dividends_paid; capex and dividends_paid are positive), plus margins, yoy_pct, roe_pct and debt_ratio_pct calculated by Livermore. Amounts are TWD, EPS is TWD per share. Taiwanese companies file Q1-Q3 quarterly and Q4 only as the full year, so single-quarter Q4 (and Q2-Q3 for companies that file half-years) is derived by subtraction (income.derived), Q4 EPS is full-year EPS minus the first three quarters (eps_derived) and single-quarter cash flows are derived from year-to-date figures (cash_flow.derived). check_failed lists accounting identities that are off by more than 1%; the figures are shown as filed. Quarterly ROE is not annualized. template is the MOPS industry format: ci general companies, basi banks, bd securities firms, fh financial holding companies, ins insurers, mim other industries. Revenue means different things per template (operating revenue for ci; net revenue, i.e. net interest income plus other net revenue, for basi and fh; revenues for bd; income for mim; operating revenue for ins through 2025 and insurance revenue under IFRS 17 from 2026, which cannot be compared, so revenue growth across that change is null), so do not compare or rank revenue across templates. Fields a format does not have are null: banks, financial holding companies and insurers have no gross profit; banks and financial holding companies have no operating income; basi, fh and ins have no current assets, current liabilities, inventory or borrowings. note explains what applies to the company; ETFs and other securities have no statements (empty periods). Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

code.description: Taiwan stock code, e.g. 2330 (TSMC), 0050 (an ETF) or 00981A. Lowercase, 2330.TW and 2330.TWO also work. Use tw_search to find a code by company name.

period.description: quarterly (default): the latest 8 single quarters; annual: the latest 5 fiscal years.

name: tw_get_financials

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

market.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

name_en.description: English short name (for example TSMC); null when there is none.

check_failed.description: Balance sheet identities that failed within 1%.

derived.description: Single-quarter cash flows derived by subtracting year-to-date figures.

consolidated.description: false for standalone statements (companies without subsidiaries).

debt_ratio_pct.description: Total liabilities divided by total assets (%).

check_failed.description: gross_profit when gross profit differs from revenue minus cost of revenue by more than 1%.

derived.description: This single quarter was derived by subtraction: Q4 is the full year minus the first three quarters, and Q2 and Q3 of companies that report half-years are derived from year-to-date figures.

eps_derived.description: eps_basic and eps_diluted were calculated by Livermore as full-year EPS minus the first three quarters' cumulative EPS (Q4 only; may differ by a few cents when the share count changed).

margins.description: Gross, operating and net income as a percent of revenue; null when revenue is not positive.

roe_pct.description: Return on equity (%): net income attributable to the parent divided by average parent equity (start and end of the period); quarterly ROE is for one quarter, not annualized.

yoy_pct.description: Growth (%) against the same period a year earlier: revenue and net income attributable to owners of the parent; null when the base is not positive or not comparable.

url.description: The financials page on tw.livermore.club (Traditional Chinese).

title: Taiwan stock: financial statements
